scripts.ready: vp fmt && vp lint && vp run test -r && vp run build -r
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,native,data -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:native" "pnpm run dev:data"
scripts.dev:ios: concurrently -n web,native,data -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm --filter native run ios" "pnpm run dev:data"
scripts.dev:data: cd apps/data && uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.check: pnpm exec vp check --fix && cd apps/data && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.test: pnpm --filter web exec vp test && cd apps/data && uv run pytest
